private.body: You're set to Private. You can still connect with anyone by their exact handle, and a connection lets you message each other whatever your setting is. To be reachable here, let your communities message you.

actions.removeConnectionBody: You will no longer be connected. If nothing else lets the two of you message each other — a community you both belong to, or both of you being open to messages — that ends with it.
